section_summary.extract_value: This section details the procedure for a single study conducted at Tsinghua University. It describes obtaining ethics approval, recruiting 728 students during a lecture break, securing consent, and administering three scales along with demographic information. Participants completed the surveys within 15 minutes and received ¥10 RMB for their involvement.
